answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the onyx until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the terrace of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lagoon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
